scientific_integrity: An analytic Hermite-contact factorization and a moment-constrained perturbation establish the global result; executable symbolic checks supplement the proof. Mathematical and publication-priority independent validation are not asserted.
scientific_limitations: Only independently sampled stage laws with the first three nonconstant uniform moments, on a scalar real-negative Dahlquist test. No nonlinear convergence-order or complex-half-plane A-stability claim. Exact optimizer below the sharp threshold is not classified.
title: Sharp moment-preserving Gaussian stage-design frontier for implicit Runge–Kutta decay
